lines.text: Is this cat ok with dogs?
I asked the same thing last week. Apparently fine with calm dogs.
Mine is a very calm old lab, so that sounds promising.
Introduce them slowly though. A closed door for the first few days helps a lot.
Anyone know if the vaccines are up to date?
The listing says vaccinated, but I'd ask for the vet card.
I saw the card at the pickup point. All current, plus a chip.
Great, thanks!
Those eyes though 😍
Right? The second photo got me.
Same. I keep coming back to this page.
How does this cat do with small kids?
Mine are 4 and 7 and we visited together. Very patient with them.
Any scratching?
None. Just walked away when it got too loud.
That's honestly the best you can ask for.
Is the price negotiable?
Probably not much. It covers the vet bills.
Worth asking anyway, the worst they can say is no.
Fair. I'll send a message.
What food is this cat on right now?
Dry food in the morning, wet in the evening, from what I heard.
Any particular brand?
Doesn't really matter, just switch slowly over a week or so.
+1. Our cat had an upset stomach when we switched overnight.
Does this cat get along with other cats?
Lived with two others before, no fights.
Good to know. I already have one, a bit territorial.
Separate food bowls and litter boxes, at least at first.
And a tall cat tree, so each one has its own spot.
Noted, thanks everyone!
Indoor only, or used to going outside?
Indoor, as far as I know.
Perfect, we're on the 6th floor anyway.
Just put a net on the balcony. Cats are braver than they look.
Has anyone actually met this cat in person?
I did, on Friday.
And? Shy or outgoing?
Shy for about five minutes, then came over for treats.
Treats solve everything.
Is there an adoption contract?
Yes, a short one. Mostly about not reselling and returning if it doesn't work out.
That's a good sign, honestly. Means they care where the cat ends up.
Long hair means a lot of brushing, right?
A few times a week is enough for most cats.
Daily in spring. The shedding is no joke.
Ok, adding a brush to the shopping list.
Get a metal comb too, it works better on the undercoat.
Can I come visit this weekend?
Send a message through the profile, visits are by appointment.
Will do. Saturday morning would be ideal.
Does this cat like being picked up?
Not really. Prefers sitting next to you rather than on you.
Plenty of cats are like that. Give it time.
Mine took a year to become a lap cat, so I get it.
Any health issues I should know about?
Nothing in the listing.
Ask for the last vet visit date, it tells you a lot.
And whether it's neutered. The price usually includes it.
Neutered, it's in the description.
Oh, missed that. Thanks.
Is this cat noisy at night?
Every cat has a 3am zoomies phase 😅
Ha, fair enough.
A good play session before bed helps a lot.
What a gorgeous coat.
Even nicer in person, the photos are a bit dark.
Agreed, I saw this cat at the pickup point.
Does this cat use a scratching post, or the sofa? 😬
Post, from what I was told.
Phew. Our last cat destroyed two sofas.
Put the post right next to the sofa at first. They go for whatever's closest.
And a bit of catnip on it. Works every time.
Is it ok for a small apartment?
Cats care more about vertical space than square meters.
So shelves and a cat tree?
Exactly. And a window to watch birds from.
How old is this cat exactly?
The listing has the birth date.
Oh, I see it now. Younger than I thought.
Young cats are a lot of energy, just so you know.
That's fine, so are my kids.
Anyone else adopt from this seller before?
Yes, two years ago. Very honest about the cat's temper.
Same here. They even called a month later to check in.
That's reassuring, thanks.
Does this cat travel well? I visit my parents a lot.
Most cats hate the car, honestly.
Leave the carrier open at home so it's not a scary box.
That worked for us. Ours naps in it now.
Smart, I'll try that.
Is the cat still available?
The listing is still up, so I guess so.
Hope so 🤞
Is this cat a big eater?
Normal, I think. Two meals a day.
Watch the treats, it adds up fast.
Ha, my last cat got chubby exactly like that.
Happens to the best of us.
What toys does this cat like?
Feather wands, for sure. I saw it go crazy for one.
Cardboard boxes. Every cat likes boxes.
The box the toy came in, not the toy itself 😂
Classic.
Is this breed hypoallergenic? My partner has mild allergies.
No cat is fully hypoallergenic, sadly.
Spend an hour with the cat before deciding. That's the real test.
Good idea, we'll visit together.
An air purifier helps too. We have one in the bedroom.
And keep the cat out of the bedroom, if you can.
Thanks, all very helpful.
Litter trained?
Yes, no accidents according to the description.
Clumping or pellets?
No idea. Use the same kind for the first weeks to be safe.
I'm a first-time cat owner. Is this a good cat for a beginner?
Calm, healthy and litter trained, so yes, I'd say so.
Read up on cat body language. It saves a lot of scratches.
And find a vet before the cat comes home, not after.
Also cat-proof the cables. Learned that one the hard way.
Wow, thanks everyone, saving all of this.
Good luck! Post a photo if you adopt.
Will do 😊
Does this cat like water? Asking for my fish tank 😅
Get a lid for the tank, whatever the answer is.
Already ordered one, just in case.
How long does the adoption process take?
For me it was a visit, then the contract a few days later.
Same. About a week in total.
Faster than I expected.
Have the carrier and litter box ready before pickup day.
Can't stop looking at this one. That face!
Tell me about it. I'm trying to convince my partner.
Show them the photo with the yarn, that's the one.
Good call 😄
Does this cat shed a lot?
Short coat, so not too bad.
Every cat sheds more than you think. Buy a lint roller.
Or two. One for home, one for the car.
